name: voicr
description: Motor de cálculo algorítmico de voicings e visualizador interativo em Rust + WebAssembly

scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --manifest-path crates/fret-wasm/Cargo.toml --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && wasm-bindgen --target bundler --out-dir web/src/wasm target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/fret_wasm.wasm
scripts.dev: npm run build:wasm && npm --prefix web run dev
scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm --prefix web run build
